name: pb
description: pn:applied gate lifecycle (pb gate create, pb gate attach-verified-child) plus pb drain isolate and the /drain-beads autonomous queue-draining command, which claims a bead and delegates the per-bead protocol to the shared pb:drain-one skill (also applied by pg-router drain workers); isolate a bead's worktree, gate a follow-up bead until `pn workspace apply` applies the change, and drain ready beads (parking/mooting/dependency-conversion via the pb:drain-stuck skill, handoff beads via the beads-lifecycle:handoff-bead skill) instead of over-using the `human` label. /unstick-beads periodically sweeps open-but-not-ready beads (blocked, deferred, human-labelled) via pb:unstick-batch-worker subagents to undefer, de-label, fix dependencies, or close stale beads. /drain-beads, /stop-draining-beads and /unblock-human-beads mark this session's current mode via the session-mode CLI (for the claude-status-line segment), with a SessionEnd hook as a backstop for a killed/crashed session.
